This changes `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` for users, so it needs a changelog fragment, e.g. `instrumentation/opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-bedrock/.changelog/1058.fixed`:

```
Include cache read and cache write tokens in `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens` for InvokeModel and InvokeModelWithResponseStream.
```
